sources.title: General Intuition Set to Raise $300M, Valued at $2B for AI Training ...
sources.snippet: TL;DR General Intuition is reportedly in talks to raise about $300 million, which would value the startup at just over $2 billion. The company is building foundation models for spatial-temporal reasoning and says Medal’s massive gaming-video dataset is central to training its AI agents.
